subject: Post-discovery: schedule 30-min product intro & stakeholder alignment
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Jordan <alex.jordan@cloudvita.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 10 Sep 2027 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Post-discovery: schedule 30-min product intro & stakeholder alignment

Hi Alex —

Thanks again for your time today — great to learn more about CloudVita's data access patterns and the latency-sensitive parts of your ingestion pipeline. Quick recap and suggested next step:

- What we agreed: Redwood can demo a 30-minute focused walkthrough showing (1) low-latency inference with prefix caching, (2) how we route to cheaper quantized variants for batch workloads, and (3) token-level cost breakdowns in the Console.
- Primary goals for the session: validate throughput for 512-token tails, confirm security and SSO fit, and surface likely cost levers.

To keep this tight, can we lock a 30-minute slot next week? Proposed windows (PDT):
1) Tue Sep 14 — 10:00–10:30
2) Thu Sep 16 — 14:00–14:30
3) Fri Sep 17 — 09:00–09:30

Please pick the one that works best and loop in any stakeholder(s) we should include — ops, security/compliance, or engineering owners. I cc'd Ben (solutions lead) who will join the demo and can cover architecture constraints.

Attachments: discovery notes (summary) — I attached a short PDF with the items we discussed. I'll circulate a 1-page agenda once we confirm a slot.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

Attachment: cloudvita-discovery-notes.pdf (1 page)
From: Alex Jordan <alex.jordan@cloudvita.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 11 Sep 2027 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-discovery: schedule 30-min product intro & stakeholder alignment

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the clear recap. Thu Sep 16 14:00–14:30 (option 2) works best for our team.

Can we include our security lead, Samir Patel (samir.patel@cloudvita.com), on the invite? He's the person who will validate KMS/HSM integrations and the audit log retention behavior.

High-level asks for the demo:
- Quick run through of routing/fallbacks under capacity constraints (5–10 minutes)
- Example Console view showing token cost and latency traces (5–7 minutes)
- Short Q&A focused on compliance and isolation options (10–12 minutes)

If you can send a one-page agenda and the calendar invite for Thu 9/16 at 14:00 PDT, we'll accept and share with Samir and our platform engineer (Sam).

—Alex
Alex Jordan
Director of Platform Engineering | CloudVita
alex.jordan@cloudvita.com | +1 (650) 555-0890

Alex — good call selecting Thu 9/16 at 14:00. I'll be on the session to run the architecture walkthrough. Priyom (cc'd) will join as the technical SME and can answer questions about batching/quantization tradeoffs.

Proposed 30-minute agenda (tight):
- 0:00–5:00 — Quick introductions & session objectives
- 5:00–12:00 — Live demo: low-latency path + prefix/KV cache example
- 12:00–18:00 — Console: token cost/latency traces and routing policies
- 18:00–28:00 — Questions: security, SSO, dedicated capacity options
- 28:00–30:00 — Next steps & mutual action items (pilot checklist)

Priyom: will you bring the sample latency traces for a 512-token tail and the recommended quantization profile? If you want, I can attach the short agenda doc ahead of the invite.

Thanks — looking forward.
Ben
